prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit that prepares the W state: an equal superposition of every computational basis state with exactly one qubit in |1> and the rest in |0> — the SAME target as the standard 5-qubit W state. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RY, CX, and X. Do NOT use a controlled-RY (CRY) gate directly — decompose any controlled rotation into RY and CX (the standard identity CRY(theta) = RY(theta/2), CX, RY(-theta/2), CX applies).
